title: Old firmware (wire proto mismatch)

setup.describe: Flash a FIXTURE build: today's firmware with `fixture-old-proto`, which reports WIRE_PROTO_VERSION - 1 in its hello. Built from source rather than restored from an archived binary — an archived old build rots against the toolchain and proves nothing about TODAY's classifier.

manual: The card should land Incompatible with the reflash affordance — that affordance is the ONE way out and must be reachable.
AFTER capturing: put the board back with the card's Update/Flash, or `just build-fw-esp32c6` + espflash. It is running firmware that lies about its wire protocol.
